the_correction_that_matters.false_claim: Contract section 3.3, first delivery: 'a route reading one of these returns a PostgREST error, not an empty result. A UI that renders "no vendors found" is therefore not evidence that an organization has no vendors.'
the_correction_that_matters.truth: Every live reader already handles the undefined-table code 42P01 and fails DEGRADED. One does it correctly and six render an ambiguous null.
the_correction_that_matters.was_it_a_regression_someone_fixed: No. `git diff 16fb834f -- <the four route files>` is empty, so the 42P01 handling was present at the base SHA. WFC-003's first delivery was wrong on the day it was written, and says so.
the_correction_that_matters.the_consequence_that_survives: These are not user-visible outages. They are PERMANENTLY UNAVAILABLE health and governance signals, five of which are indistinguishable in the response body from a genuine null. An organization with expiring vendor contracts, lapsed compliance documents or stalled signature envelopes reads as 'nothing to report'. CP-098 is explicit that a plausible zero is the failure this program exists to prevent, so these are launch-graph facts even though no error is thrown.

what_this_is_not.not_a_fix: WFC-003 created no table, wrote no migration, and changed no route. The routes already handle the condition; whether the tables ship is a schema decision.
